title: CyberWitch theme suite: kit, website, Space page, Spotlight, email, /themes/cyberwitch, and every builder

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: create a full theme suite from CyberWitch.zip, every surface, marketing page in the same format, in every builder system, validated and live

detail:
CyberWitch is its own theme (id `cyberwitch`, editor theme `CyberWitch`, tokens --cw-*): industrial street-punk witch, dark only, one neon accent, UnifrakturCook + Permanent Marker + Spectral. Built in stages, each its own PR, the theme hidden from every picker (RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS) until the last lands.

Stage 1 (this row's first PR): tokens (lib/theme/cyberwitch.ts), site skin and block sheet, registration in the site-style, mega-theme, surface, contract, editor, presentation, preview and Spotlight tables, theme contract entry, block-contract map, manifest. Deviation: Volt (#8A70FF) is a violet, so five accents ship, not six (violet family retired, ADR-1792). Stage 2: fonts, photos, six starter kits. Stage 3: Spotlight layouts, Space page face, emails. Stage 4: /themes/cyberwitch in the Nocturne page's format, design-system intake, probes, un-hide.
